marketing_description: The DeWALT DCK225D2 delivers 20 V performance with a brushless motor and MAX Atomic™ Lithium‑Ion 2 Ah batteries, providing up to 16 % more power for drilling and 1,700 in‑lb of torque in the 1/4 in impact driver. Both tools feature compact designs—5.88 in drill/driver head length and 5.1 in impact driver length—with onboard LED illumination, tool‑free battery change, and a soft case with belt hooks, and the kit includes a rapid charger and a three‑year limited warranty.
